description: This file defines an interface for reading client transactions in the Fineract platform. It specifies methods to retrieve all transactions, a specific transaction, and transaction by external ID, acting as a platform service contract.

classes.name: ClientTransactionReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface providing methods to read client transaction data within the platform, enabling retrieval of transaction lists, individual transactions, and external ID-based lookups.

methods.name: retrieveAllTransactions
methods.description: Fetches all transactions for a given client, optionally filtered by SearchParameters.

methods.name: retrieveAllTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves transactions for a client filtered by a charge ID.

methods.name: retrieveTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a specific transaction for a client based on transaction ID.

methods.name: retrieveTransactionByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves a transaction using an external identifier.
